comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Vertically integrated homebuilder selling homes to consumers with mortgage services; Forestar sells finished lots to builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers, plus mortgage and rentals; lot development is only a side activity, though it is Forestar's parent.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling to homebuyers with mortgage and title; buys lots rather than developing them for sale.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops land into finished lots, selling some to third-party builders; the closest listed peer, though homebuilding is larger.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling built-to-order homes to consumers; it is a lot buyer, not a lot developer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Option-lot homebuilder with mortgage banking, selling homes to consumers; it avoids land development, unlike Forestar.
